topic: remove dust spots from a camera sensor
core_question: How do I get rid of dust spots showing up in my photos from the camera sensor? (secondary: How do I make the top row stay on screen as I scroll down a spreadsheet?)
answer_summary: Use a rocket air blower on the sensor in the camera's manual sensor-cleaning mode; if spots persist, use a dedicated sensor cleaning swab with sensor cleaning solution, or have it professionally cleaned.; after the topic shift: On the View tab, choose Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row so the header stays visible while scrolling through the rest of the sheet.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; writing in full careful sentences
